title: First month as an indie developer
prompt: Write a personal journal-style blog post (about 600 words) about my first month after quitting a salaried software job to build small indie apps. It was lonelier and slower than I expected, I shipped two tiny apps that almost nobody downloaded, and I'm still not sure it was the right call. Write it in first person, ready to publish.

title: Injured before the half marathon
prompt: Write a personal journal-style blog post (about 600 words) about training four months for my first half marathon and then straining my calf three weeks before race day. Write it in first person, ready to publish on my blog.

title: Workshop fountain pen
prompt: Write the product page copy (about 250 words: a headline, a short intro, three short sections, and a call to action) for the Laneway Pen: a refillable stainless-steel fountain pen made by a two-person workshop in Melbourne. It costs AUD 140, takes standard international cartridges or a converter, weighs 32 g, and comes with a lifetime nib-replacement promise.

title: Job-site app for renovation crews
prompt: Write a launch email (about 250 words, with a subject line) for Punchlist, a mobile app for small renovation crews (2 to 10 people) that turns photos of a job site into a shared task list with due dates. It works offline, costs USD 12 per user per month, and has a 14-day free trial. The audience is small-builder business owners who currently run jobs over group texts.

title: The birthday candle
prompt: Write a short story (about 1,200 words). Premise: a night-shift pharmacist notices that the same customer comes in every week and buys a single birthday candle.

title: The storage unit
prompt: Write a short story (about 1,200 words). Premise: two estranged sisters have one weekend to clear out their late father's storage unit before the lease runs out.
